We appreciate hearing your comments and concerns. Feedback is used to make our site serve you better.
Parcels include unincorporated Scott County and Park View, as well as the Cities of Bettendorf, Blue Grass, Buffalo, Davenport, Dixon, Donahue, Durant, Eldridge, LeClaire, Long Grove, Maysville, McCausland, New Liberty, Panorama Park, Princeton, Riverdale and Walcott.

Important November 3 General Election Dates
Scott County Auditor Kerri Tompkins announces important dates for the upcoming November 3 General Election. “Please plan ahead so you can be sure to cast your ballot,” says Tompkins.
Posted: Monday, October 12, 2026
Fight the Flu!
The best way to prevent the flu is to get an annual flu shot. Everyone 6 months and older should get a flu shot every year, ideally before the end of October. Make time to get your flu shot. It's a small step that can make a big difference!
Posted: Thursday, October 1, 2026
Protect Your Farm and Family from the Flu
It's important for those who are in close contact with pigs, dairy cows, poultry, or other animals to get their flu shot as protection against influenza viruses. This includes farmers, workers, and family members or close contacts of farm workers.
Posted: Monday, September 14, 2026
